4. Visual Inspection: I examined the wing tips and leg joints specifically. The wing veins terminate naturally without melting into the background. The legs connect logically to the thorax. There is no 'halo' effect around the insect. The shadowing under the legs suggests proper contact with the ground.

No new artifacts were found. The severity ratings (none) are accurate.
